info.name: cclu-api
info.description: Manual testing collection for the CCLU API. Every endpoint lives in the folder of the module that owns it. The collection stores no credentials: create a Postman environment of your own and set the variables this collection declares.

item.name: Health
item.description: Service and database reachability. Not part of the domain.

request.description: Returns 200 with "database": "connected" when the API reached MongoDB, and 503 with "database": "disconnected" when the process started but the connection is down.

Answers 204 and sets the session cookie, which Postman keeps in its jar and returns on its own. Invalid credentials always answer 401 with the same message, whether or not the address is an account. Ten failures from one address within fifteen minutes answer 429.

204 and the session cookie when the application is approved and the account active. 401 with one message for a wrong password or an address that is not an account. 403 with a reason once the password was right but the application is pending or rejected, or the account suspended.
Returns the identity behind the session cookie. Postman stores the cookie on sign in and sends it back on its own, so there is nothing to paste here.
Clears the session cookie. Needs no authentication, so an expired session can still be closed.

Public. Sends a single-use link to the address when it belongs to an account, and answers the same whether or not it does, so the form cannot be used to find out who has an account. Rate limited per address and per account.
Public. Says whether the link in the mail can still be used, before the person types a new password. A link that was used, expired or never existed answers the same refusal.
Public. Spends the token and sets the new password, which follows the same rules as at registration. The token cannot be used twice.

request.description: Public, since nobody has an account yet. Answers 201 with the identifier alone, and writes to the applicant on the address they registered with. Role and application status are set by the server and ignored if sent. A repeated identifier answers 409 with a message that names nothing. An empresa or an asociación sends the razón social, its legal representative and the personería jurídica; a profesional independiente sends their own name instead.
Member session. The profile of the member signed in; the identity comes from the session, never from the request.
Member session. Only the editable fields are read; anything else in the body is ignored. Each field is validated with the same rules as at registration.
Member or administrator session. Says whether a member code belongs to an active member. Rate limited.

Member session. The plan the member holds now, worked out against the clock: a paid plan past its expiry reads as Gratuita with its lapse, even before the hourly job has moved it. expiresAt is the instant the plan ends, in UTC, for a screen to show on the viewer's clock; validUntil is its last valid day in Costa Rica (YYYY-MM-DD), for messages from the chamber. Both are null on Gratuita. A member without a membership is granted Gratuita on the first read.

Needs the member session. Nothing about the account changes here: the address being claimed is written to the message this sends, and only answering it applies the change. The address on file stays in place until then. An address another account holds answers 409, and the address the account already has answers 400.

item.name: Applications
item.description: The three answers a registration can receive. Until the admin screens exist, these requests are how a decision is made: the applicant is told by email, and a rejection or a request for changes hands them a link to send it back.

request.description: What waits for a decision, oldest first, so whoever has waited longest is seen first. Needs an administrator session; the password hash is never part of the answer.
Approved, rejected and asked-for-changes applications, most recent first. Asking for changes is an answer too: the chamber has looked at the application and the next move is the applicant's.

Draws the member code, leaves the account able to sign in and writes the applicant with their code. The code is unique, so a collision is answered by drawing another one. An application that is not pending answers 409 with the state it is in.

Closes the application and tells the applicant why. No member code is drawn: a code is the mark of belonging to the chamber, and a rejected applicant never belonged. The message carries a personal link to correct and send it again.

The answer between approving and rejecting: the application is kept and the applicant is told what to fix. A field outside the list the correction form can show answers 400, because asking for one would send the applicant looking for a field that is not there, and a field named without a reason of its own answers 400 for the same kind of reason. The applicant is told the reason, every field with what is wrong with it, and the link.

item.name: Corrections
item.description: Reached only by the link a rejection or a request for changes carries. Public on purpose: somebody whose registration was refused cannot sign in, so the token in the link is the proof that the application is theirs.

request.description: Every field the applicant may correct, with its stored value, plus the reason, what the chamber said about each field it named, who decided and when, and the address, which the link cannot change. A link that expired, was already used, or belongs to an application that is no longer awaiting the applicant answers 404 with the same message.

request.description: Reads the fields the correction screen shows against the same rules the registration answers to, and sends the application back to pending review. The address, the password, the consents and everything the screen does not show are not read here: they are preserved rather than corrected. A member type and an identification type that do not go together answer 400, and the identity that does not go with the chosen type is cleared. The link is spent on the way out, so sending twice answers 404.

item.name: Read the address change the link carries

request.description: Public, because the message may be opened on another device. Says which address the link would apply, and answers 404 with the same message once it expired, was used, or belongs to nothing.
Applies the pending address and spends the link in the same write, so the same message cannot be replayed. A duplicate on the unique index answers 409 without naming whose address it is.
Closed list the registration form offers. Public.
The accepted economic activities the registration form offers. Public. An applicant whose activity is missing writes it out instead, and it joins this list when the chamber approves the registration.

Public, because a registration carries its uploads before the applicant has an account. Answers 201 with the key, which is what the registration sends. The purpose decides the folder: membership-certifications, member-logos or payment-receipts. The owner names the member or administrator the file belongs to; a registration that has no account yet uses the identifier its form generated. Only the purposes a registration carries are accepted here: member-logos and membership-certifications. The type is checked against the file's own bytes; 5 MB at most.
Public. Serves only files anybody may see, such as logos, with nosniff and a sandbox policy. Any private key, a receipt or a certification, answers 404.

item.name: Open a file as an administrator

request.description: Administrator session. Opens any stored file, including private ones such as the certification of a registration, with the same protective headers.
Administrator session. The profile of the administrator signed in.
Administrator session. Only the name can be changed here.
Public. Approved members whose account is not suspended, alphabetical, twelve to a page. search matches a card code or a business name; district needs canton.
Public. The districts where a listed business is, each written once, for the directory filter.
Public. The page a member card's QR code opens: public fields, open branches (no municipal permit), the shop's week and categories, and the paid plan while it holds. Only for an active member.
Public. The four plans with their monthly fee in whole colones and their entitlements, in display order. Not paged: it is a closed catalog.

Administrator session. Every key is checked before anything is written. Gratuita cannot be priced, an amount equal to the current one is not a change, and an amount is a whole number from 1 to 1000000. Each change is written with its audit entry in one transaction; a fee another administrator changed first answers 409 changed_meanwhile.
Administrator session. The fee history from the audit log, newest first, paged as { items, page, pageSize, total, pageCount }.
Administrator session. How many days before an expiry members are reminded and the panel counts a plan as expiring soon, with the allowed range.

Administrator session. A whole number of days from 1 to 30. Written against the value seen, with its audit entry in one transaction; a value another administrator changed first answers 409 changed_meanwhile.

Administrator session. Paid plans in force only; Gratuita, and any plan that ran out, is not listed. view is active (default) or expiring, the part that ends within the notice; plan is lite, pro or premium; search matches the business name or the start of the member code. Answers the page with counts { active, expiring } and the notice in force, soonest to expire first.
Administrator. Members, pending applications and payments, paid memberships by plan, memberships expiring soon and active vacancies, read now.

item.name: Check whether a payment can be made

request.description: Member session. canSubmit, and when it is false the reason: payment_pending while one waits for review, or renewal_not_open with opensOn, the day the renewal window opens. Also the reference to write on the transfer.

Member session, multipart. plan is lite, pro or premium; file is the receipt (JPG, PNG or PDF, 5 MB, checked by its bytes); comment and resubmissionOf are optional, the latter the id of a rejected payment of yours. Answers 201 pending. 409 payment_pending, renewal_not_open or receipt_already_used.
Member session. Newest first, optionally filtered by status: pending_review, approved or rejected.
Member session. 404 for a payment that is not yours.

item.name: Open the receipt of one of my payments

request.description: Member session. The receipt itself, with nosniff and a sandbox policy. 404 for a payment that is not yours.

Administrator session. status is pending_review (default, oldest first), approved or rejected (newest decision first). search matches the business name or the start of the member code. counts carries the number in each state.
Administrator session. The payment with its member, earlierAttempts (the member's rejected payments) and sameReceipt (other payments with the same receipt).
Administrator session. The receipt itself, with nosniff and a sandbox policy.
Administrator session. Moves the membership to the plan paid for in one transaction with the audit entries, and mails the member. 409 already_decided, account_suspended or receipt_already_used.
Administrator session. reason is 10 to 300 characters and is mailed to the member. 409 already_decided.
Member session. The approved registration becomes the first branch on the first read, so a member never opens on an empty list of the place they already registered.

request.description: Member session. name, canton, district and address are required. isPrimary takes the flag from the branch that had it; the first branch is primary whatever the body says. municipalPermit is only ever read by the chamber.
Member session. Only the fields sent are rewritten, and an optional one sent empty is taken off the branch. 400 nothing_to_change.
Member session. Answers with the branches that are left. 409 last_branch: a member keeps at least one. Closing is a date, so the record stays readable.
Member session. Always answers the whole week; a day nobody set is closed.
Member session. The schedule is the week: a day left out is closed. A day must close after it opens. Categories are catalog references, five at most. 400 nothing_to_change.
Member or administrator. The session's own notices, newest first, paged, with the number unread.
Member or administrator. 204, or 404 when the notice is not the session's own.
Member or administrator. Marks every unread notice of the session read. 204.
Member. Own vacancies, newest first, paged, with canPublish for the current plan.
Member on a plan with publishJobs. 403 plan_required otherwise. The branch must be one of the member's open branches.

request.description: Member session on a plan that includes publishInMarketplace, otherwise 403 plan_required. A product or a service takes price and imageUrl; a promotion takes startsAt and endsAt; a discount takes percentage (1-90), condition and the two days.
Member session. The type does not change: a product does not become a promotion, because the two ask for different things.

item.name: Take it down or put it back

request.description: Member session. status is active or inactive. 400 not_allowed when the chamber took the publication down: only the chamber can put it back.
Member session. 204. The publication keeps its date, so the reports still count what was published.
No session. Active publications inside their validity, offered by businesses that hold a paid plan. The search is read as text, never as a pattern.
No session. 404 when it was taken down, ran out of its validity, or its business no longer holds the plan.
